overall: The AG found the Lowell School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide requested meeting minutes within ten days, and ordered future compliance; other allegations were not found violations or were declined.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the committee failed to provide requested meeting minutes within ten days; minutes were given only after the complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee failed to provide meeting minutes within ten days upon request, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged minutes for all 2013-2016 meetings related to the Policy were still not provided.
allegations.key_passage: Absent evidence to the contrary, we find that the Committee provided the complainants with minutes for all meetings related to the Policy as requested.

allegations.summary: Not alleged; the AG found on its own that the June 24, 2015 subcommittee minutes lacked enough detail and encouraged revision.
allegations.key_passage: A member of the public who did not attend this meeting would not be able to read these minutes and understand the nature of the Joint Subcommittee's substantive policy discussion.

allegations.summary: Not alleged; AG reminded the committee that its May 4 notice omitted the topic of the pending Open Meeting Law complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We note that the Committee failed to post on the notice for its May 4 meeting a topic related to discussion of this Open Meeting Law complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainants raised notice sufficiency for June and July 2015 meetings only in their later review request, not the original complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Because these additional allegations were not included in the original complaint, we do not review them.

allegations.summary: Complainants sought meeting notes, notices, and attendee lists; these are public records matters, not Open Meeting Law minutes.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review the allegation as it pertains to documents other than minutes

allegations.summary: Complaint was also addressed to the City of Lowell and the Lowell Public School District, which are not public bodies under the law.
allegations.key_passage: Because the City and the School District are not public bodies within the meaning of the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, § 18, we do not review the allegations against them.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar conduct in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
